$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocomplete.

repository.description: owner/repo of this repository. Lets `uses: owner/repo/.github/workflows/x.yml@ref` resolve locally.

rules.description: Severity per rule, keyed by code (FP401) or name (empty-binding-for-matrix-combo).

nestingDepth.description: Maximum workflows in one call chain, counting the top-level workflow (FP602).

maxInputs.description: Inputs on one workflow_call interface before FP605 suggests grouping them.

ignore.description: Repo-relative path prefixes or globs (`*`, `**`) whose findings are suppressed.

overrides.description: Accepted findings, each with a reason and an optional expiry date.

rule.description: Rule code (FP104) or name (unused-input) to suppress.

target.description: Symbol the finding is about, e.g. `.github/workflows/ci.yml#inputs.legacy`. Supports `*` and `**`.

file.description: Repo-relative file path, prefix or glob the finding is located in.

reason.description: Why this finding is accepted. Required, at least 10 characters.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). After the end of this day the finding is reported again, together with FP901.

matrixShapes.description: Declared keys of runtime-computed matrices, keyed by `<workflow path>#<job id>`. Lets flowpact verify `matrix.*` reads (FP404) instead of reporting FP403.

generated.description: Which workflow and action files are generated. Rules about their internals are not reported there; flowpact detects them by a header comment or the `.lock.yml` name.

include.description: Files or globs of workflows and actions that are generated, even without a marker.

exclude.description: Files or globs of workflows and actions written by hand, even with a marker or a `.lock.yml` name. Wins over `include`.

plugins.description: Repo-relative JavaScript modules (.js/.mjs) exporting extra rules (default export: rule or array of rules).

impact.description: Impact mode: which units are published and how pull requests declare their release impact.

publish.description: Files or globs of the units other repositories use. Default: every workflow with `workflow_call` except `_`-prefixed files, and the root `action.yml`.

declaredBy.description: The authoritative source of the declared impact; others are advisory. Default: `explicit` when given, else `title`.

labels.description: Pull request labels that declare each impact level.

types.description: Conventional Commits types and the impact they declare; other types declare `none`, `!` declares `major`.

uncertain.description: Changes flowpact cannot fully resolve: only warn (default), or count them towards the required impact.
